rites.name: Thornouktok
rites.text: Thornouktok is the concept of a resonant seed-tone that rang through Syezeth during the Singing, when the first roots of the world began to condense from drifting dust. It is remembered as the chord that held the young land together through the Age of Sundering, when each landfall tore an old bond loose.

rites.name: Osurareno
rites.text: Osurareno is a concept of Syezeth set in the Seeding, the age when the makers plant the Weave and its quiet powers lie dormant. It is not a being but a sleeping potential, a pattern of latent force waiting to be woken by the first hands that touch the Weave.

rites.name: Orirallia
rites.text: Orirallia is the concept of the sundering flame, the force that broke the Syezeth worlds apart in the Fall and left their Shards drifting in the void. In the Holy Age its name was spoken in every temple and sworn upon in the Pact, binding the orders to guard the fragments that remain.

rites.name: Fenorar
rites.text: Fenorar is a concept of Syezeth, the sworn principle that a broken world may be mended by shared flame, first named in the Fall before the Sundering split the sky into Shards. It became the central doctrine of the Holy Age, when temples and orders kept its embers burning across the surviving worlds.

rites.name: Corines
rites.text: A practiced art where a machine draws energy into the sky to brew a storm, then routes the captured lightning through its own frame, often out through a fingertip or a blade. Later makers have carried it forward in many forms.

rites.name: Ceostirnus
rites.text: A machine's sealed governors are loosened so stored energy floods out at once, lifting it far past its normal limits. The surge is brief and leaves the machine needing a long recovery to avoid burning out its core.

rites.name: Sastilum
rites.text: A narrow beam of light fired from a body part, usually the eyes, that is weak but used to draw attention or knock aside incoming shots. Tuned to a higher frequency, it can pierce the sky and shove back a large armored war machine.

rites.name: Sheizis
rites.text: Sheizis is a concept entry in the Syezeth universe: a stellar-era war engine whose mind is an autonomous machine intelligence rather than any living pilot. Born from a fallen engineer's partner-unit design and completed in diminished form by a rival faction, she moves with her own purpose across a star-scale theatre.

rites.name: Osiazora
rites.text: Osiazora is a hidden research citadel in the Syezeth stellar realm, founded in the sixth era to harness light-born energy for clean power. Its scientists later turned its discoveries toward defensive weaponry and piloted constructs, all shielded by a luminous barrier that drinks in incoming fire.

rites.name: Zephesasha
rites.text: Zephesasha is a sunken coral sanctum off the Syezeth shelf, where a retired fleet engineer named Ilyan Vosk-Terran reclaimed a drifting star-forge hull and rebuilt it into a hidden crucible for training aerial wardens. Within its tidal halls, pilots learn to fold reactor flux into ceremonial armor, and the sanctum's vaults hold the blueprints for the colossus Oruvane Thresh.

rites.name: Seitheth
rites.text: Seitheth is a deep-sky observatory cloaked in orbital lattices that listens for the faint signatures of distant minds across the Syezeth reaches. Its researchers have long catalogued alien life, and they now coordinate the defenses of their homeworld against an approaching imperial armada.
